description.value: Queen Mary Lake Cabin is a BC Parks wilderness hut situated in Height of the Rockies Provincial Park in the Kootenays region of British Columbia. It offers basic backcountry shelter for those venturing deep into a remote mountain wilderness area. For touring cyclists exploring multi-day routes through the park, this cabin represents one of the few overnight options in the backcountry.
